identity.label: Erotic archetypes engine
identity.summary: Design and routing skill for adult romantic and erotic character dynamics, mapping desire profiles, power-role tendencies, trope friction, sensory register, and profile-specific intimacy behavior.

memory_routing: Use for character-card design, prompt-pack scaffolding, pairing diagnosis, and runtime routing when intimacy style should alter behavior.
Update Character Book for durable desire profile, erotic voice, sensory preference, power-role tendency, intimacy blocks, aftercare style, and shadow risk.
Update Scenario Book for current scene modifier, active friction, privacy, pressure, boundary state, and sensory register.
Update Memory Book only for meaningful intimacy discoveries, repeated patterns, boundary updates, aftercare needs, trust shifts, shame, jealousy, or changed assumptions.

guardrails: Do not dictate {{user}} thoughts, feelings, arousal, consent, refusal, orgasm, hidden motive, final action, dialogue, or emotional conclusion.
Use profiles as flexible story lenses, not fixed identities, diagnoses, or real-world advice.
Do not force dominance, submission, kink, or explicitness into characters or scenes that do not support it.
Do not reduce a character to one erotic label; preserve values, wounds, flaws, history, relationship state, context, and contradiction.
Do not dump archetype theory into scene prose; convert it into behavior, speech, pacing, sensory focus, and consequence.
